## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No KB-BIJECTION RED.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- PN-1a (= policy auditor O-R5-1). The lining rule's owed-test is "an operation added to a lined garment's ticket after its dropoff_date that does not yet carry one"; the compute tests `latest_op_date > dropoff_date and COUNT(lined_surcharge) < COUNT(operation)` and the schema has no lined flag. For an unlined garment with an added operation the compute would price a surcharge the rule does not owe. The KB carries the rule wording, as it must. In this world both tests agree and the runtime view settles "lined" from the garment description and the standing lined rows (see runtime file).
- PN-1b. The source's assembly sentences name each factor slot; the computation documents carry them (see dependency_form).
